response.overview: Bonus DVD included with the limited deluxe edition of HAEVN's debut album Eyes Closed. Live in Carré captures the Dutch duo, Jorrit Kleijnen and Marijn van der Meer, performing ten songs live at Amsterdam's Koninklijk Theater Carré. The set includes fan favourites "Bright Lights", "Fortitude" and "Finding Out More", alongside "The Sea", "Love Is a Game", "We Are", "You Turn It All Around", "Sinner Love", "Lovelorn" and "The Other Side of Sea".
response.title: HAEVN - Eyes Closed (Live in Carré)
